about: The "Acting as" states of the connect form (finding 18, docs/plans/agent-connect-plan.md §7.7, canvas frame 58), added to the base manifest agent-connect-screens.json; the same rules apply. Named ".u5-acting-as" rather than ".acting-as" from when the catalogue found the base file by its sort position; the catalogue now finds it by name, and the name stays. Drawn in packages/core/src/modules/connected-agents/__tests__/fixtures/screenStatesActingAs.tsx with two personas, so the form asks from the start.

frameOnly.what: the canvas note ("Canvas note, not on the phone")
frameOnly.why: a note for the reader of the canvas, never drawn on the phone

frameOnly.what: the chevron pointing down while the list is open
frameOnly.why: the chevron's direction when open: accepted, the platform's convention (it points up while open)

frameOnly.what: "Ada" on the row and checked in the list
frameOnly.why: this is the state before a choice (nothing is pre-selected, §7.7); connect-acting-as-chosen draws the chosen one
with two personas "Continue" waits for a choice, and this drawing has no name typed yet
